validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort within the PLCO screening trial reporting dietary genistein intake and incident prostate cancer risk with hazard ratios.

extraction.comparison_type: Quintile 5 vs quintile 1 of dietary genistein intake (advanced prostate cancer)
extraction.population: Men in the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial

sample_size.excerpt: During a median follow up of 11.5 years, 2,598 cases of prostate cancer (including 287 advanced cases) have been identified among 27,004 men in the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.

cases.excerpt: During a median follow up of 11.5 years, 2,598 cases of prostate cancer (including 287 advanced cases) have been identified among 27,004 men in the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.

effect_size.excerpt: After adjustment for confounders, an increased risk of advanced prostate cancer [HR (95% CI) for quintile (Q) 5 vs. Q1] was found for the dietary intake of total isoflavones [1.91 (1.25-2.92)], genistein [1.51 (1.02-2.22), daidzein [1.80 (1.18-2.75) and glycitein [1.67 (1.15-2.43)] (p-trend for all associations ≤0.05).

confidence_interval.excerpt: After adjustment for confounders, an increased risk of advanced prostate cancer [HR (95% CI) for quintile (Q) 5 vs. Q1] was found for the dietary intake of total isoflavones [1.91 (1.25-2.92)], genistein [1.51 (1.02-2.22), daidzein [1.80 (1.18-2.75) and glycitein [1.67 (1.15-2.43)] (p-trend for all associations ≤0.05).
